services.name: Thanksgiving on the River
services.desc: A delicious experience! 2 Hours Thanksgiving, imagine a day where the only thing on your to-do list is to relax, enjoy, and savor every moment with your loved ones—no cooking, no cleaning, just a beautiful two-hour cruise through the heart of Chattanooga. Step aboard the Southern Belle Riverboat, where a whimsical Thanksgiving adventure awaits, one filled with laughter, delicious food, and unforgettable views of the Tennessee River. As the Southern Belle gracefully glides through the sparkling waters, you’ll feel the joy of togetherness without any of the usual stress. 2 Hour Cruise • Ages 3+

It’s the perfect way to celebrate the season with your closest friends without any of the usual 2 hours • Lunch and Sightseeing
